3139-4779-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3139-4779-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
3139-4779-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing The Great Henge, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

3007-4828-5261.easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3007-4828-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3007-4828-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Toymaker.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

1753-2137-4642.description:
Cast Awaken the Woods with X equal to 3 by paying {3}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two lands you control to their owner's hand, copying Awaken the Woods.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Woods, creating three 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature tokens.
Activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.
1753-2137-4642.notes: Once you have infinite green mana and infinite land tokens, you may activate Uyo any number of times, targeting any number of instant or sorcery spells.

1339-1832-4050-5931.easyPrerequisites:
Funeral Room is unlocked.
Your life total is at least 2.
1339-1832-4050-5931.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Insect, adding one mana of any color
When the Insect dies, Funeral Room triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

628-3899-6672.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrifiicing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. When it enters, Bloodied Ghost will put a -1/-1 counter on itself, removing the +1/+1 counter.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Bloodied Ghost.
When Bloodied Ghost dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

483-1981-2415-4247.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

81-1887-2021-2060.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

206-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
206-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
206-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

1479-2841-6157-7705.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.
1479-2841-6157-7705.description:
Fetch a land using Bant Panorama.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

891-1703-3967.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Fool's Demise's first and second ability triggers.
Resolve the first trigger, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Fool's Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the second Fool's Demise ability, doing nothing,.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1283-2440-7082-7311.description:
Activate Improvised Arsenal by paying {5}, creating a token copy of it.
Sokka and Suki triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the creature token.
Repeat.
1283-2440-7082-7311.notes: The mana cost can be reduced if you control more creatures that share type(s) with the created tokens as the combo begins. With infinite mana, the Improvised Arsenal tokens can be attached to creatures you control to make them infinitely large.

141-3967-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1069-1256-4460-5499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three artifacts.
1069-1256-4460-5499.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Saproling.
Activate the Saproling by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

1978-5168-5776.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
1978-5168-5776.description:
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat

628-5147-7217.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Moonshadow.
When Moonshadow dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

997-4605-6132-7260.description:
Cast Nature's Rhythm from your hand by paying {6}{G}{G} or from your graveyard for its harmonize cost by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2511-4316-4871-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
2511-4316-4871-5220.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

2781-4681-6798.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Karmic Guide
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Karmic Guide
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4452-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Rukarumel, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Repeat from step 3.
2034-4452-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

3490-4017-4659-6720.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-4017-4659-6720.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

1409-2719-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
1409-2719-7009.description:
Activate Sakashima using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Sakashima by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Sakashima enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Sakashima.
Repeat each turn.

1987-3617-4423-6991.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4423-6991.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Donnie & April.
When Donnie & April and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

850-1978-5056.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
850-1978-5056.description:
Cause Overgrown Battlement to become an artifact using Neurok Transmuter.
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat from step 2.

3234-3293-5414-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-5414-6798.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-5414-6798.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

431-1308-6441-6753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1308-6441-6753.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

1939-2034-4593-6291.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the creature tokens die, Luminous Phantom triggers twice if it's on the battlefield, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.
1939-2034-4593-6291.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1445-2267-4871-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2267-4871-6798.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Tormod triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1170-1414-6643.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using Edgar this turn if Lotus Petal is in your graveyard.
1170-1414-6643.description:
Cast Lotus Petal from your hand or graveyard by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Edgar.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2279-4050-5751-5763.description:
Cast Circle of the Land Druid from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {1}{G} and discarding a land card.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
When Circle of the Land Druid enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature token and Circle of the Land Druid, adding {1}{G}.
When Circle of the Land Druid dies, its second ability triggers, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Quintorius triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4487-4934-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary and Amareth trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Amareth trigger, causing you to reveal Phyrexian Marauder from the top of your library and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1636-3484-4023-4840-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Dr Madison Li does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least five energy counters.
1636-3484-4023-4840-5256.description:
Activate Dr Madison Li's third ability by tapping it and paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, returning Myr Battlesphere from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Myr Battlepshere enters the battlefield, it, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module triggers.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Decoction Module trigger, causing you to get {E}.
Resolve the Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating four 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens.
When the Myrs enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Decoction Module trigger four times.
Resolve all Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve all Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Myr Battlesphere, causing target player to mill cards equal to Myr Battlesphere's power.
Repeat.

2084-4284.notablePrerequisites: Clone is a copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
2084-4284.description: Activate Clone by paying {1}{U}, shuffling Clone into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

2493-4050-4485-4598.description:
Cast Essence Flux by paying {U}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Docent of Perfection triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Wizard token.
Resolve Essence Flux, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Essence Flux from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Human Wizard, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2021-2060-2265-4772.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

174-570-1636-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You control a black permanent.
Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
174-570-1636-2034.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Worldheart Phoenix, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Worldheart Phoenix from your graveyard by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Worldheart Phoenix enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

813-1987-3075-5116.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
813-1987-3075-5116.description:
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
